answer: Walnut Beacon Challenge Each agent must solve a cryptographic puzzle derived from a public beacon value updated every epoch. The puzzle requires finding a nonce such that hash(walnut || beacon || nonce) ends in a prefix matching the current saffron threshold. The beacon is generated via verifiable randomness from a decentralized oracle, ensuring unpredictability. An attacker cannot precompute solutions because the beacon changes each epoch and depends on real-time inputs. To participate, each identity must submit a valid solution within one hour of beacon publication.
